|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-71-front-master.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force]] (original, release sheet of 4 September 2009); [[Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); '''this page''' (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Red 5 or Rogue 1 (or armed with Luke's Lightsaber), may add one destiny to total power or attrition, and I Have You Now is canceled. When leaving table, place all your cards on Luke in Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 4.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 (this page), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=11, page 11. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=11 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “67” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “When leaving table, place all your cards on Luke” to “When Luke leaves table, place all your cards on him”: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Red 5 or Rogue 1 (or armed with Luke's Lightsaber), may add one destiny to total power or attrition, and I Have You Now is canceled. When Luke leaves table, place all your cards on him in Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 4.”.<ref name="cl-1261_71-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-lukeskywalkerstrongintheforce-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force]]) again, word for word: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Red 5 or Rogue 1 (or armed with Luke's Lightsaber), may add one destiny to total power or attrition, and I Have You Now is canceled. When leaving table, place all your cards on Luke in Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 4.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual6-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual6-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034714/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “67” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 11)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force]]) again, word for word: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Red 5 or Rogue 1 (or armed with Luke's Lightsaber), may add one destiny to total power or attrition, and I Have You Now is canceled. When leaving table, place all your cards on Luke in Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 4.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-71-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “67”).
